notes: Synthetic test trees. Priest Holy mirrors the shape of WoW Forever's tree (names, tiers, max ranks, quirks); descriptions are shortened.

talents.name: Unbreakable Will
descriptions: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear and Silence effects on you by 3%.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
descriptions: Increases your damage with Wands by 5%.

talents.name: Twilight Focus
descriptions: Gives your spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Improved Renew
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

talents.name: Holy Specialization
descriptions: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

talents.name: Spell Warding
descriptions: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Divine Fury
descriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
descriptions: After being struck by a critical hit, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec.

talents.name: Inspiration
descriptions: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 0% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Holy Reach
descriptions: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Healing
descriptions: Reduces the Mana cost of your heals by 15%.

talents.name: Searing Light
descriptions: Increases your Holy damage done by 10%.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
descriptions: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
descriptions: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
descriptions: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 2%.
Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

talents.name: Lightwell
descriptions: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest.

talents.name: Spirit Tap
descriptions: Gives you a 20% chance to gain 100% bonus Spirit after killing a target.

talents.name: Blackout
descriptions: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
descriptions: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 3 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
descriptions: Reduces your target's chance to resist your Shadow spells by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Heroic Strike
descriptions: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.

talents.name: Deflection
descriptions: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
descriptions: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target.

talents.name: Cruelty
descriptions: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee weapons by 1%.
